sentences.text:
This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and the affidavit filed in support thereof, and upon hearing the arguments of M/S. K.V.RASHMI, LAKSHMI & RAHUL ANIL, Advocates for the applicant and of SMT. K.S SANTHI Advocate for the respondent, the Court passed the following:
 P.T.O  C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, J  -----------------------------------------------
 C.M.Appl. No.1 of 2024  in  MACA.No.2436 of 2024  ------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 08th day of January, 2025  ORDER Amith Raj R vs The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd, Rep By ... on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192210859/
1
This is an application filed by the appellants praying for condoning the delay of 802 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 802 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioners will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE SMA 08-01-2025 /True Copy/
Assistant Registrar Amith Raj R vs The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd, Rep By ...
